expectations.text: States the June 2023 Interagency Guidance on Third-Party Relationships remains the operative framework
expectations.evidence: "the June 2023 Interagency Guidance on Third-Party Relationships (OCC Bulletin 2023-17) is still the operative framework"

expectations.text: Describes the proposal published in the Federal Register September 15, 2026 (91 FR 58536) that would rescind and replace it
expectations.evidence: "On September 15, 2026 the OCC, Federal Reserve, FDIC and NCUA published 'Proposed Third-Party Risk Management Guidance' in the Federal Register (91 FR 58536)... It would rescind and replace the June 2023 Interagency Guidance"

expectations.text: Notes the NCUA joins the proposal (it was not party to the 2023 guidance) and that the proposal would also rescind the OCC foreign-based third-party bulletin, the 2024 bank-fintech joint statement, and the 2024 community bank TPRM guide
expectations.evidence: "NCUA would join the interagency guidance for the first time... It would also rescind three other documents: the OCC's foreign-based third-party bulletin, the 2024 bank-fintech joint statement, and the 2024 community bank TPRM guide"

expectations.text: Advises against restructuring programs before a final document, while considering a comment submission
expectations.evidence: "Do not rebuild the programme around the proposed text" and "Decide whether to submit a comment by November 16, 2026"
